## HubSpot custom object retention archiver
Weekly hygiene job: finds custom object records untouched for RETENTION_DAYS, writes an immutable, checksum-verified backup to S3 and/or Google Sheets, then archives (DELETE → recycle bin) only the verified records.

**Safe by default:** DRY_RUN=true, SANDBOX_MODE=true, MAX_ARCHIVE_PER_RUN=500. No DELETE runs unless every storage target verified this run.

**Instance settings:** N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false · NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto only if Sheets uses a service account.

Code nodes are generated from `src/` — edit there and run `npm run build:workflow`.
